results.name: prins1995_urosepsis
results.source: Prins JM, van Agtmael MA, Kuijper EJ, van Deventer SJ, Speelman P. J Infect Dis 1995;172(3):886-91
results.caveat: The cytokine difference was NOT statistically significant (P > .05) at n=30, so this supports direction only. The 10-40% figure is the magnitude bound used separately.

results.name: simpson2000_melioidosis
results.source: Simpson AJ, Opal SM, Angus BJ, Prins JM, Palardy JE, Parejo NA, Chaowagul W, White NJ. J Infect Dis 2000;181(3):1014-9
results.caveat: ENDOTOXIN ONLY. Reading the paper's tables (see SIMPSON_2000_TABLES) shows the cytokine arm does not support the model and numerically trends the other way: ceftazidime's median peak IL-6 was LOWER than imipenem's (291.9 vs 594.8 pg/mL; P = .36), and peak cytokines did not correlate with peak endotoxin (IL-6 r = .23, P = .18). Earlier phases of this project cited this study as supporting the direction in 'endotoxin and cytokines'; that was wrong and is corrected here. The endotoxin difference also did NOT translate into a survival difference, so the model must never be read as predicting mortality.

results.name: prins1995_whole_blood
results.source: Prins JM, Kuijper EJ, Mevissen ML, Speelman P, van Deventer SJ. Infect Immun 1995;63(6):2236-42
results.caveat: Closed ex-vivo system with no danger-signal clearance, so only the ordering transfers, not the absolute concentrations.

prins_source.source: Prins JM, Kuijper EJ, Mevissen ML, Speelman P, van Deventer SJ. Infect Immun 1995;63(6):2236-42
prins_source.reports: At 0.5x MIC the differences between antibiotics in endotoxin and cytokine levels were small, with levels comparable to untreated cultures.
prins_source.model_must_predict: sub-MIC exposure produces little cytokine induction relative to an untreated control, and little separation between agents
prins_source.bears_on: Phase 1 concluded that the sub-MIC filamentation pathway contributes <=1% of danger-signal release at conventional exposures. This is independent corroboration from a different readout (cytokine induction rather than release kinetics) and a different laboratory.

conflict.prins_e_coli: at 0.5x MIC, endotoxin and cytokines comparable to untreated; small differences between agents
conflict.jackson_kropp_p_aeruginosa: sub-MIC ceftazidime released LPS matching the amounts at 1-50x MIC, without significant lysis
conflict.model_behaviour: reproduces Jackson & Kropp (Y_filament anchored on P. aeruginosa)
conflict.implication: Y_filament is bounded above by Prins and is plausibly organism-dependent; unresolved
conflict.why_not: the Phase 1 in-vivo result is limited by sub-MIC WINDOW TIME, not by release per cell, and survived a 10-fold increase in Y_filament

bound.source: Prins JM, van Agtmael MA, Kuijper EJ, van Deventer SJ, Speelman P. J Infect Dis 1995;172(3):886-91
bound.comparator: no rise in the imipenem arm
bound.interpretation: The ceftazidime-attributable cytokine rise in treated gram-negative urosepsis is a modest fraction of the patient's pre-treatment level, not a multi-fold increase.

layer1_held_out.fit_source: Trautmann M, Zick R, Rukavina T, Cross AS, Marre R. J Antimicrob Chemother 1998;41(2):163-9
layer1_held_out.fit_assay: LPS capture ELISA, monoclonal anti-O18; detection limit 2 ng/mL; verified free of antibiotic interference (their table I)
layer1_held_out.held_out_source: Jackson JJ, Kropp H. J Infect Dis 1992;165:1033-41
layer1_held_out.interpretation: magnitude fails, ordering transfers; the assay difference is the most likely explanation and is supported by three independent estimates landing at 3.5-7x

per_cfu_yield_check.conclusion: absolute per-CFU yield is unidentified without matched growth curves; ratios are unaffected

unvalidated: Layer-1 ABSOLUTE per-CFU yields (section 6c). The held-out RATIO test has now been run non-circularly against Trautmann and the ordering transfers, but the absolute yield per CFU killed remains unidentified: Yamaguchi implies 4.93 fg/CFU over an ASSUMED inoculum while Trautmann over its measured inoculum naively implies 1240, which exceeds a whole cell's LPS content. Resolving it needs Trautmann's figure 1 growth curves digitized. No conclusion in this study depends on the absolute value.

Absolute magnitude: bounded only by Prins' relative figure, and the model currently over-predicts it (section 4). Needs the focus volume and translocation fraction to be anchored on something measured.
Agent-specific kill kinetics: both arms still share one kill function, though Jackson & Kropp report imipenem reducing counts ~2 log more than ceftazidime at 2 h at sub-MIC concentrations.

Local versus plasma danger signal: Ernst 1999 found imipenem improving every rat lung-injury measure over aztreonam WITHOUT a plasma-endotoxin difference, which a single plasma compartment cannot represent.
Outcome: Simpson 2000 found a significant endotoxin difference and NO mortality difference. The model predicts inflammatory exposure and must not be presented as predicting survival.
